mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 250.0, it signals elevated inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above their 3-month moving averages fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 90.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI index (CPIAUCSL) indicate aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 0.1 and CPIAUCSL > 250.0 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing contraction regime (INDPRO < 90.0), declining industrial output reduces corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
